fit_quality_policy.background_amplitude_gt_1: Catastrophic-background diagnostic flag only. Headline metrics are reported both with all fits and in a sensitivity view excluding this flag; no post-hoc replacement fit is performed.
fit_quality_policy.parameter_at_bound: Diagnostic nuisance flag only. It is not a headline-event exclusion because the aggregate flag mixes peak-shape, tail, rotation, and background nuisance boundaries.
fit_quality_policy.primary_nonphysical: Successful optimizer result outside 40-200 GeV; reported separately and excluded only from physical-localization numerators.
fit_quality_policy.primary_optimizer_failure: Reported separately; never silently removed from denominators.
fit_quality_policy.secondary_invalid_or_sentinel: Reported separately; never interpreted as a measured second peak.
fit_quality_policy.secondary_nonphysical: Valid non-sentinel solution outside 40-200 GeV; reported separately.

interpretation_boundary: This is an unweighted control-sample robustness study. It is not a cross-section-weighted efficiency, calibrated mistag estimate, mass-resolution measurement, or expected sensitivity.

scientific_design.duplicate_fit_policy: No event already present in the accepted p_signal > 0.997 products is refitted.
scientific_design.sampling_policy: Exhaustive within the deterministic 1,000-event ZH and ZZ released-model products; no first-N cap and no spread-sample cap.

ZH.definition: Sort the two fitted coordinates; lower within 15 GeV of mZ and higher within 15 GeV of mH.

ZZ.definition: Both fitted coordinates within 15 GeV of mZ.
